title: The little house
intro: Reza's grandparents live in a little old house in Masuleh, a mountain village in Gilan, in the green north of Iran. The story practises describing a home: rooms, colours, 'there is' (هست) and 'has' (دارد), and the ezafe that links a noun to the words after it (خانه‌ی بالایی, 'the house above'). Look out for the strange thing about the roofs of Masuleh.
source: An original story for this course.

sentences.fa: این خانه‌ی پدربزرگ و مادربزرگ رضا است.
sentences.r: in khāne-ye pedar-bozorg o mādar-bozorg-e Rezā ast.
sentences.en: This is the house of Reza's grandfather and grandmother.
sentences.faV: این خانه‌یِ پِدَربُزُرگ و مادَربُزُرگِ رِضا اَست.

sentences.en: The house is small and old.

sentences.fa: ماسوله یک روستا در کوه‌های شمال ایران است.
sentences.r: Māsule yek rustā dar kuh-hā-ye shomāl-e Irān ast.
sentences.en: Masuleh is a village in the mountains of northern Iran.
sentences.faV: ماسوله یِک روستا دَر کوه‌هایِ شُمالِ ایران اَست.

sentences.fa: خانه دو اتاق و یک آشپزخانه دارد.
sentences.r: khāne do otāgh o yek āshpaz-khāne dārad.
sentences.en: The house has two rooms and a kitchen.
sentences.faV: خانه دو اُتاق و یِک آشپَزخانه دارَد.

sentences.en: The walls of the house are yellow.
The windows are small and made of wood.

sentences.fa: در اتاق بزرگ، یک فرش قرمز و یک سماور هست.
sentences.r: dar otāgh-e bozorg, yek farsh-e ghermez o yek samāvar hast.
sentences.en: In the big room there is a red carpet and a samovar.
sentences.faV: دَر اُتاقِ بُزُرگ، یِک فَرشِ قِرمِز و یِک سَماوَر هَست.

sentences.en: The roof of the house is very interesting.

sentences.fa: بام این خانه حیاط خانه‌ی بالایی است!
sentences.r: bām-e in khāne hayāt-e khāne-ye bālāyi ast!
sentences.en: The roof of this house is the yard of the house above!
sentences.faV: بامِ این خانه حَیاطِ خانه‌یِ بالایی اَست!

sentences.fa: مردم هم روی بام راه می‌روند.
sentences.r: mardom ham ru-ye bām rāh mi-ravand.
sentences.en: People walk on the roof too.
sentences.faV: مَردُم هَم رویِ بام راه می‌رَوَند.

sentences.fa: رضا هر تابستان به ماسوله می‌آید.
sentences.r: Rezā har tābestān be Māsule mi-āyad.
sentences.en: Reza comes to Masuleh every summer.
sentences.faV: رِضا هَر تابِستان به ماسوله می‌آیَد.

sentences.fa: خانه کوچک است، اما دل مادربزرگ بزرگ است.
sentences.r: khāne kuchak ast, ammā del-e mādar-bozorg bozorg ast.
sentences.en: The house is small, but Grandmother's heart is big.
sentences.faV: خانه کوچَک اَست، اَمّا دِلِ مادَربُزُرگ بُزُرگ اَست.

options: in a village in the mountains of northern Iran
by the sea in the south

questions.q: How many rooms does the house have, apart from the kitchen?
What is special about the roof?
options: it is the yard of the house above
it has a garden with trees

questions.q: When does Reza come to Masuleh?

after: Masuleh is built on a slope so steep that the flat roof of one house is the yard – or the street – of the house above, and people really do walk across their neighbours' roofs. Notice the two ways of saying 'there is': در اتاق بزرگ یک فرش قرمز هست 'in the big room there is a red carpet', and خانه دو اتاق دارد 'the house has two rooms' – Persian often says 'has' where English says 'there is'. The walls are plural but the verb could also be singular: with things (not people), Persian often uses a singular verb after a plural subject. And the family words are easy to build: پدربزرگ 'grandfather' is just پدر 'father' + بزرگ 'big', and مادربزرگ is 'big mother'.
